rules.label: Income-based discount
rules.quote: If your gross household income is at or below 250% of the federal poverty level:

rules.label: Payment plan eligibility
rules.quote: You have the right to a payment plan based on your income.

payment_plan.quote: Your monthly bill cannot be more than 4% of your monthly income.

notes: Policy mentions eligibility for public health coverage programs like Health First Colorado, CHP+, Emergency Medicaid, CICP, and hospital discounts for uninsured patients.
Policy states that insured patients must request eligibility screening for discounts and public coverage programs.
Policy includes appeal rights: 30 days from decision to file an appeal.
Policy allows complaints to be filed with hospital, provider, or Department of Health Care Policy and Financing.
